groups.activity: Mirror Defense, stay through Rotation B
conditions: Parts roll only on the B reward, so a run that leaves after two rotations cannot drop them. Rewards run AABC.
Fragments ignore Resource Boosters and Smeeta Charm.
Only Citrine's Remnants heal the crystals; Vacuum, Fetch and Mag's Pull do not collect them.
A full shop set is 1,250 Belric + 750 Rania, about eight or nine Steel Path runs with no part drops.
bonuses: Every rotation pays 10 of each fragment (15 on Steel Path), and each 50 Remnants picked up pays 5 more (7 on Steel Path).
Mirror Defense also appears in Arbitrations, paying Vitus Essence alongside the fragments.
The same mission and currency also farm Citrine and Corufell.

disclosures.title: squad and frame
disclosures.body: Solo is slow because one player cannot defend and collect Remnants at once. Titania is the near-unanimous pick for Remnants, with Jade and Chroma named too. Remnants spawn thickest in the Void tunnel between halves, and hitting 50 there gives the crystal its overshield.

disclosures.title: spend fragments last
disclosures.body: Run for drops first and buy only the one or two pieces that refuse to drop, so you do not end up with duplicates. Extract after Rotation B for Steflos alone; stay for C only for Citrine's parts, and past four rotations leave on a multiple of four.

conditions: Steflos Prime is a separate Mastery item with its own relic farm.
